messages:
Tara: Quick weekly pulse — token momentum & throughput. QoQ: +9% token consumption overall, WoW: +3%. Spikes on Tue 10:15 UTC that pushed p95 latency to 420ms (baseline 210ms). Errors up to 1.8% (from 0.7%). Spend pace +14% QoQ, main driver: two customers (AcmeCo and Brightline) using longer context and higher temperature runs.
Ben: noted. any onboarding accounts moving to prod this week? thinking renewal flags.
Tara: AcmeCo finished onboarding last week; their traffic doubled after turning on streaming. Brightline still in POC, but their qps is already 3x expected.
Nisha: seeing a drop in embedding tokens for one cohort — likely due to new quantization suggestion. That saved ~8% tokens on batch jobs.
Kevin: digging into runtime — noticed batching window changed from 20ms->60ms on one cluster config, which explains p95 jump. rolling diag now.
OpsBot: [alert] cluster-gpu-7 latency spike at 2025-06-10T10:14:43Z — autoscale triggered.
Ben: can we get per-cust token/day and cost/day? need for renewal risk for Brightline (they're at 78% of committed tokens).
Jordan: financials — if Brightline goes full prod this month, estimate +$12k/mo. Also renewal outreach due in 30 days for AcmeCo.
Tara: Action items: Kevin to rollback batching window on cluster-gpu-7 (in progress), Nisha to confirm quantization rollout doesn't affect quality (A/B eval), Ben to prepare per-customer token & spend sheet by EOD Wed, Jordan to draft renewal playbook for AcmeCo. I'll run enablement session with Brightline next Thu. :thumbsup: 
Kevin: rolled back window, p95 down to 220ms, errors back to 0.9% — monitoring for regressions.
Nisha: A/B eval shows no measurable degradation on the top 50 prompts; will publish checklist.
Ben: uploaded token/spend sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/CS-token-spend-179210 — added notes on committed vs actual.
Jordan: flagged AcmeCo renewal as 'at-risk' in CRM, scheduling 1:1 with their PM Friday.
Tara: thanks team. we'll re-check same time next week. if anyone sees new anomalies ping #eng-oncall.
